generation.mode: built-in ImageGen edit with edit-target as Image 1 and style canon as reference-only Image 2

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No whole-cell sun gradient or cast-shadow field is visible, but basalt top planes are repeatedly paler than vertical faces and the conifers retain bright-left/dark-right modelling. The literal equal-value lighting rule is not met.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Broad coherent cliff-top bench counts as buildable; exposed column faces and steep cliff-base talus count as steep; broken margins, loose rock, scrub, and conifers make up the remainder. Approximate uncertainty is plus or minus 0.08 per fraction.

west.required: the northern 64 percent is open sea and only the lower remainder carries ground

crown.method: Full-frame dark-green connected-component census visually confirmed all five conifers, including both south-edge crowns; source widths 49, 50, 57, 81, and 86 px give a 57 px median scaled by 2560/1254.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Classified source-raster teal and blue from canvas-edge connectivity, grew the selection through adjacent painted foam, surf, wash, reflections, and water gaps between shore rocks, removed a 21-pixel false wet speck, and inspected the full-source overlay. Dry cliffs, talus, stacks, and skerries remain transparent terrain.

refusalReasons: The continuous west-edge ground begins at source row 545, about 43.5 percent down, instead of at the required 64 percent boundary near row 803; roughly 258 rows of the protected open-sea run are land.
Land occupies 904 of 1254 south-edge pixels although that edge is required to be sea.
The delivered dry footprint reaches source x=1008, about 78.5 m from the west edge, rather than ending within the required 15-40 m coastal continuation.
Five conifers were introduced on the new headland even though none visibly arrive with the neighbour's ground, and their measured 5.585 m median exceeds the accepted 1.7-5.2 m territory band.
Repeated pale column caps over darker vertical faces violate the literal neutral-lighting rule.
Several cliff runs read as clean repeated upright columns with level cap rhythms rather than consistently weathered, split, leaning, irregular coast geology.
openRisks: The water mask is mechanically binary, connected, same-size, and overlay-inspected, but it faithfully classifies the noncompliant source topology rather than correcting it.
Buildable and steep fractions and crown outer-foliage widths are image measurements, not surveyed geometry.
The square result made the framing-only retry unavailable, so no second ImageGen call was made.
No artifact was promoted outside quarantine; visual quality remains owner and director judgment.
